name: Ergeshui
description: Ergeshui was a world that existed within the galaxy. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, the bounty hunter Boba Fett went to the world to deliver a human bounty to the alien criminal Tusk, who subsequently executed the human for backstabbing them sometime in the past.
